step.waiting_engine: Waiting for Docker to be ready

engine.recovered: The previous session ended unexpectedly; storage was checked and recovered.
engine.service_hint: The Solon background service must be running. Reinstalling Solon repairs it.

error.title: Something needs your attention
error.VIRTUALIZATION_DISABLED_IN_FIRMWARE: Hardware virtualization is disabled. Enable Intel VT-x or AMD-V in your BIOS/UEFI settings (usually under Advanced or CPU), then start Solon again.
error.UNSUPPORTED_WINDOWS_EDITION: Solon requires Windows 11 Pro, Enterprise or Education. Windows Home does not include the components Solon needs.
error.WINDOWS_FEATURE_MISSING: A Windows component is missing. Reinstall Solon to enable it; a restart may be required.
error.WINDOWS_FEATURE_BLOCKED_BY_POLICY: Your organization restricts enabling Windows components. Ask your administrator to enable Hyper-V and Virtual Machine Platform.
error.HYPERVISOR_NOT_RUNNING: The Windows virtualization engine is not running. Common causes: an older VirtualBox/VMware, virtualization disabled at boot, or running inside another virtual machine.
error.HOST_COMPUTE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: A Windows service Solon depends on (Host Compute Service) is stopped or missing. Restart Windows; if it persists, reinstall Solon.
error.BLOCKED_BY_SECURITY_SOFTWARE: A security product is blocking Solon. Add the Solon folder to its exclusions.
error.INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES: Solon does not have the rights it needs. Reinstalling Solon repairs the background service.
error.VM_CONFIGURATION_REJECTED: Windows rejected the engine configuration. Please report this with the log file.
error.VM_BOOT_TIMEOUT: The engine did not start in time.
error.AGENT_UNREACHABLE: The engine started but is not responding.
error.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Docker did not become ready in time.
error.IMAGE_CORRUPTED: The container engine files are missing or corrupted. Reinstall Solon.
error.DATA_DISK_ERROR: The storage disk could not be created or opened.
error.HCS_ERROR: The virtualization layer returned an error.

containers.title: Containers
containers.empty: No containers yet. Run one with the docker CLI or from an image.
containers.search: Filter by name, image or status

remove_confirm.title: Remove container {{name}}?
remove_confirm.body: The container and its writable layer will be deleted. Named volumes are kept.

containers.no_match_hint: Try another name, image or status.

start.title: No container yet
start.hello_body: Pulls the tiny hello-world image and runs it once: it prints a greeting and exits. Solon then opens its logs so you can read it; the stopped container stays in this list.
start.compose_body: Pick a folder containing compose.yaml: Solon shows its services, merged logs and Up / Down buttons.
start.cli_body: The docker CLI is already on your PATH and talks to Solon. Anything you start shows up here.
start.cli_hint: Every running container also gets https://<name>.solon.local, with or without published ports.
start.stack_body: WordPress, Odoo, PostgreSQL, n8n, Nextcloud, Redis… a compose.yaml written for you, started in one click, with its solon.local address.

containers.sleeping_hint: Paused by Solon after a period of inactivity. Wakes up on the first request.
containers.exited_quickly: {{name}} started, did its job and exited with code {{code}} within two seconds. That is normal for a one-shot image such as hello-world: its output is in the logs.

terminal.stopped: The container must be running to open a terminal.

debug.hint: Toolbox shell sharing the container's processes, network and volumes — works even when the image has no shell. Target filesystem under /proc/1/root.
debug.stopped: The container must be running to open a debug shell.

files.title: Files
files.help: Copy files between the container and Windows (docker cp).
files.stopped_note: Sending files requires a running container; copying from a stopped container works.

detail.keep_awake_help: Never put this container to sleep, even when idle.
detail.rename_hint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash. A Compose-managed container gets its name back at the next Up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saved: Saved. Changes apply at the next engine start.
settings.diagnostic_help: Bundle the logs, state, settings and versions into a zip file to attach to a bug report. No credentials are included.
settings.legacy_fs: Use the legacy Windows file sharing (9P) for mounted folders
settings.legacy_fs_help: Fallback if a container misbehaves with the Solon file system. Slower. Applies at the next engine start.
settings.sleep_help: Containers reached through Solon (solon.local addresses or published ports) are paused when nobody talks to them; they wake up on the first request in a fraction of a second. Databases and background workers that only talk internally are never affected.
settings.resume: When the engine starts, restart the projects and containers that were running when it stopped
settings.resume_help: Covers Windows restarts, installs and Stop / Start from Solon. Docker alone only restarts containers marked restart: always or unless-stopped.
settings.autostart_none: No project is marked “Always start with Solon” yet (checkbox on each project card).

projects.title: Projects
projects.welcome_hint: Three ways to get your first project running. Everything you start gets an https://….solon.local address.
projects.welcome_open_body: A folder with a compose.yaml starts as is. A folder without one: Solon looks at what it contains and proposes an environment.
projects.welcome_stack_body: WordPress, PostgreSQL, n8n, Nextcloud, Django, Next.js… a compose.yaml written for you, started in one click.
projects.welcome_hello_body: Runs the tiny hello-world image once and opens its logs: proof that the engine works, in ten seconds.
projects.no_address: No web port detected; the services are listed below.
projects.address_when_running: The address appears when the project runs.
projects.always_start_hint: Started every time the engine starts, even if it was stopped before.
projects.no_dir: Started outside Solon: its folder is unknown.

env.hint: Values from .env and from the environment: blocks of compose.yaml, editable here; comments and layout are kept.
env.address_hint: Given by Solon from the project and service names; nothing to configure.
env.dotenv_hint: variables shared by every service, referenced as ${VAR} in compose.yaml
env.no_vars: No environment variable for this service.
env.no_services: No services: block found in the Compose file.

project.backup_hint: One zip file: the Compose files, the .env and the data of every volume. Restore it from the Projects home.

disk.title: Disk
disk.engine_stopped: Start the engine to see its usage.
disk.file: The engine keeps everything in one file, {{size}} on disk: {{path}}. It grows with use and only gives space back after a clean-up.
disk.low: Drive {{drive}} is almost full ({{free}} left). Solon's storage takes {{engine}}; removing unused images gives space back.
disk.low_short: This drive is almost full. Windows and Solon both slow down when it is; free some space.
disk.reclaim_help: Removes the images no container uses and the build cache, then gives the freed space back to Windows. Containers (running or stopped) and volumes are never touched.
disk.nothing_unused: Every image is used by a container; nothing to remove.
disk.reclaimed: Done: {{images}} image(s) and {{cache}} build cache entries removed, {{size}} freed.
disk.confirm_body: {{count}} unused image(s) (about {{size}}) and the build cache will be removed. Pulling them again later takes a download.
disk.confirm_keeps: Containers, running or stopped, and volumes are kept.
